translations.literal: In the seventh year he memorialized impeaching former acting governor Zu Binggui: "Unfamiliar with circumstances—before Guangsi had arrived, at the drill ground reviewing troops he declared he would exterminate all the Miao, causing stubborn Miao to resist and laboring the army while moving the masses.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1729) he memorialized impeaching former acting governor Zu Binggui: "Unfamiliar with circumstances—before Zhang Guangsi had even arrived, he reviewed troops at the drill ground and declared he would exterminate all the Miao, causing stubborn Miao to resist and wasting troops on a large-scale campaign.

sentences.zh: 臣不敢隱諱」。

translations.literal: Your servant dares not conceal this."
translations.idiomatic: Your servant dares not conceal this."

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「生苗必經此懲創，方可久安。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "The raw Miao must undergo this chastisement before they can be long at peace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "The raw Miao must undergo this chastisement before they can be secure for the long term.

sentences.zh: 朕以祖秉圭不勝任，已予罷退。

translations.literal: I considered Zu Binggui incompetent and have already dismissed him.
translations.idiomatic: I considered Zu Binggui incompetent and have already dismissed him.

sentences.zh: 此類情事，焉能逃朕鑑察耶？」

translations.literal: How could such circumstances escape My scrutiny?"
translations.idiomatic: How could such circumstances escape My scrutiny?"

sentences.zh: 九年，以老致仕，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, on account of age he retired from office and was advanced to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (1731), on account of age he retired from office and was advanced to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十年，請改籍四川成都。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he requested transfer of household registration to Chengdu in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year (1732) he requested transfer of household registration to Chengdu in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 旋卒，賜祭葬，諡襄壯。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died; sacrificial and burial honors were granted, and he was posthumously titled Xiangzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died and was granted state funeral honors, with the posthumous title Xiangzhuang (Resolute and Strong).

sentences.zh: 王郡，陝西乾州人。

translations.literal: Wang Jun was a native of Qianzhou in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun was from Qianzhou in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十年，陝西飢，就食福建，以李姓入伍，補台灣鎮標把總，遷延平城守千總。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Kangxi Shaanxi suffered famine; he went to Fujian to seek food, enlisted under the surname Li, was appointed platoon commander in the Taiwan garrison banner, and was transferred to company commander defending Yanping city.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year of the Kangxi reign (1691) Shaanxi suffered famine. He went to Fujian to seek food, enlisted under the surname Li, was appointed platoon commander in the Taiwan garrison banner, and was later transferred to company commander defending Yanping city.

sentences.zh: 六十年，台灣民硃一貴為亂，總督滿保檄郡赴援。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year the Taiwan commoner Zhu Yigui raised rebellion; Governor Man Bao ordered Jun to go to his aid.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year (1721) the Taiwan commoner Zhu Yigui raised a rebellion; Governor Man Bao ordered Wang Jun to go to his aid.

sentences.zh: 自廈門渡海，一晝夜至淡水，佐守備陳策固守，與策安集民、番。

translations.literal: Crossing the sea from Xiamen, he reached Tamsui in a day and a night; he assisted Garrison Commander Chen Ce in holding firm, and together with Ce settled the people and the aborigines.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the sea from Xiamen, he reached Tamsui in a day and a night. He assisted Garrison Commander Chen Ce in holding the city firm, and together with Ce settled the Han settlers and the aborigines.

sentences.zh: 師至諸羅，往會，從克台灣。

translations.literal: When the army reached Zhuluo he went to join it and followed in the recovery of Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Zhuluo he went to join it and took part in the recovery of Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 二歲中四遷。

translations.literal: Within two years he was promoted four times.
translations.idiomatic: Within two years he was promoted four times.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，擢浙江嚴州副將，奏復姓。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he was promoted to deputy commander at Yanzhou in Zhejiang and memorialized to restore his original surname.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Yongzheng reign (1723) he was promoted to deputy commander at Yanzhou in Zhejiang and memorialized to restore his original surname.

sentences.zh: 尋又遷江西南贛總兵。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was again moved to commander-in-chief at Nangan in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was transferred to commander-in-chief at Nangan in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 六年，調台灣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was transferred to Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1728) he was transferred to Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 九年，上以郡在台灣，三年任滿，例當調內地，命總督劉世明選代郡者。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, because Jun was in Taiwan and his three-year term was complete, by regulation he should be transferred to the interior; the emperor ordered Governor Liu Shiming to select a replacement for Jun.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (1731), because Wang Jun was serving in Taiwan and his three-year term was complete, by regulation he should be transferred inland. The emperor ordered Governor Liu Shiming to select someone to replace him.

sentences.zh: 世明舉海壇總兵呂瑞麟，令赴台灣就郡諮度兵民風土，乃調郡潮州。

translations.literal: Shiming recommended Commander-in-Chief Lu Ruilin of Haitan, ordered him to go to Taiwan and consult with Jun on military and civilian conditions and local customs, and then transferred Jun to Chaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shiming recommended Commander-in-Chief Lu Ruilin of Haitan, had him go to Taiwan to consult with Wang Jun on military and civilian conditions and local customs, and then transferred Wang Jun to Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 十年，擢福建提督。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to provincial military commander of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year (1732) he was promoted to provincial military commander of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 台灣北部社番為亂，瑞麟與台灣道劉象愷往剿，郡赴台灣鎮撫。

translations.literal: The northern She aborigines of Taiwan rebelled; Ruilin together with Taiwan Circuit Intendant Liu Xiangkai went to suppress them, while Jun went to Taiwan to pacify the region.
translations.idiomatic: The northern She aborigines of Taiwan rebelled. Lu Ruilin together with Taiwan Circuit Intendant Liu Xiangkai went to suppress them, while Wang Jun went to Taiwan to pacify the region.

sentences.zh: 南路亂渠吳福生等竊發，郡率兵於虎頭山、赤山、碑頭諸地逐捕，擒福生，餘黨悉平，加都督同知。

translations.literal: On the southern route the rebel ringleader Wu Fusheng and others secretly rose; Jun led troops in pursuit at Hutou Mountain, Chishan, Beitou, and other places, captured Fusheng, and pacified the remaining followers entirely; he was advanced to Associate Commissioner-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the southern route the rebel ringleader Wu Fusheng and others secretly rose. Wang Jun led troops in pursuit at Hutou Mountain, Chishan, Beitou, and other places, captured Fusheng, and pacified the remaining followers entirely. He was advanced to Associate Commissioner-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 尋北路大甲西、沙轆、牛罵諸社番殺掠兵民，郡自鹿仔港偵知阿束一社有北崙、西崙、東崙、惡馬諸地，為亂番所聚，令游擊邱有章、李科等攻西崙，參將李廕樾、游擊林黃彩等攻東崙、惡馬，而游擊黃貴，守備蔡彬、蔡棨等攻北崙。

translations.literal: Soon afterward on the northern route the aborigines of Dajiaxi, Shalu, and Niuma and other communities killed and plundered soldiers and civilians; Jun, reconnoitering from Luzai Harbor, learned that the Asheyi community had Beilun, Xilun, Donglun, Emo, and other places where rebel aborigines had gathered; he ordered Mobile Battalion Commander Qiu Youzhang, Li Ke, and others to attack Xilun; Brigade Commander Li Yinyue and Mobile Battalion Commander Lin Huangcai and others to attack Donglun and Emo; and Mobile Battalion Commander Huang Gui, Garrison Commander Cai Bin, Cai Qi, and others to attack Beilun.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward on the northern route the aborigines of Dajiaxi, Shalu, Niuma, and other communities killed and plundered soldiers and civilians. Reconnoitering from Luzai Harbor, Wang Jun learned that the Asheyi community held Beilun, Xilun, Donglun, Emo, and other places where rebel aborigines had gathered. He ordered Mobile Battalion Commander Qiu Youzhang and Li Ke and others to attack Xilun; Brigade Commander Li Yinyue and Mobile Battalion Commander Lin Huangcai and others to attack Donglun and Emo; and Mobile Battalion Commander Huang Gui and Garrison Commanders Cai Bin and Cai Qi and others to attack Beilun.

sentences.zh: 亂番設伏拒我師，督兵奮擊，悉討平之，加左都督。

translations.literal: The rebel aborigines set ambushes to resist our army; he urged the troops forward in fierce attack and suppressed them entirely, and was advanced to Left Commissioner-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel aborigines set ambushes to resist the government forces. He urged his troops forward in fierce attack and suppressed them entirely, and was advanced to Left Commissioner-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十一年，調水師提督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to naval provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1733) he was transferred to naval provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 十二年，疏言：「廈門環海，地少人多，需米不貲。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he memorialized: "Xiamen is surrounded by sea; land is scarce and people numerous, and rice is needed in no small amount.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year (1734) he memorialized: "Xiamen is surrounded by sea; land is scarce and the population is large, and the need for rice is immense.

sentences.zh: 加以營兵赴糴，難免匱乏。

translations.literal: Added to this, when garrison troops go out to buy grain, shortages are hard to avoid.
translations.idiomatic: When garrison troops go out to buy grain on top of that, shortages are hard to avoid.

sentences.zh: 水師提督公廨舊有官房，魚池賃於民，歲得息五千餘。

translations.literal: The naval commander's yamen formerly had official buildings and fish ponds rented to commoners, yielding more than five thousand in interest each year.
translations.idiomatic: The naval commander's yamen formerly had official buildings and fish ponds rented to commoners, yielding more than five thousand taels in interest each year.

sentences.zh: 請買穀貸於兵，俟穀熟買補，數年內可得數万石。

translations.literal: I request purchasing grain to lend to the troops; when the grain matures it can be bought back to replenish the stores—in a few years tens of thousands of piculs can be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: I request purchasing grain to lend to the troops; when the harvest comes in it can be bought back to replenish the stores—in a few years tens of thousands of piculs can be accumulated.

sentences.zh: 孤島兵民，庶無虞艱食。」

translations.literal: On this isolated island, soldiers and civilians may be spared anxiety over scarce food."
translations.idiomatic: On this isolated island, soldiers and civilians may be spared anxiety over scarce food."

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「郡將應得租息籌濟兵食，甚可嘉也。」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Commander Jun used the rental income due him to provide for the troops' provisions—a highly commendable act."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "Commander Jun used the rental income due him to provide for the troops' provisions—highly commendable."

sentences.zh: 命議敘。

translations.literal: An order was issued to record his merit.
translations.idiomatic: An order was issued to record his merit.

sentences.zh: 尋入覲，途次遘疾，遣太醫診視，賜藥餌。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he presented himself at court; on the road he fell ill, and an imperial physician was dispatched to examine him and medicine was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he presented himself at court. On the road he fell ill; an imperial physician was dispatched to examine him and medicine was bestowed.

sentences.zh: 二子：守乾、守坤隨侍，召入見，賜守乾守備銜，守坤戶部主事。

translations.literal: His two sons Shouqian and Shoukun accompanied him in attendance; they were summoned to audience; Shouqian was granted the rank designation of garrison commander, and Shoukun was appointed a secretary in the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: His two sons Shouqian and Shoukun accompanied him in attendance. They were summoned to audience; Shouqian was granted the rank designation of garrison commander, and Shoukun was appointed a secretary in the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，復入覲，賜鞍馬、弓矢。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he again presented himself at court and was granted saddle, horse, bow, and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Qianlong reign (1736) he again presented himself at court and was granted a saddle, horse, bow, and arrows.

sentences.zh: 時部議許民間得制鳥槍防盜，郡言：「台灣遠在海表，番、漢雜處。

translations.literal: At that time the ministries deliberated permitting the populace to manufacture muskets for defense against bandits; Jun stated: "Taiwan lies far beyond the sea; aborigines and Han live intermixed.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the ministries deliberated permitting the populace to manufacture muskets for defense against bandits. Wang Jun stated: "Taiwan lies far beyond the sea; aborigines and Han live intermixed.

sentences.zh: 禁例一開，恐火器充斥。

translations.literal: Once the prohibition is opened, I fear firearms will fill the land.
translations.idiomatic: Once the prohibition is lifted, I fear firearms will proliferate.

sentences.zh: 小則侵界擾番，大則偶遇水旱，群不逞藉以為亂。

translations.literal: In small matters they will encroach on boundaries and harass the aborigines; in great matters, should drought or flood chance to occur, the unruly will rely on them to raise rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: At a small scale they will encroach on boundaries and harass the aborigines; at a large scale, should drought or flood chance to occur, the unruly will rely on them to raise rebellion.

sentences.zh: 台灣民居多平衍，山箐中皆生番，各險要皆置兵戍守。

translations.literal: Taiwan's common dwellings are mostly on level ground; in the mountain ravines are all raw aborigines, and at every strategic point troops are stationed to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan's settlements are mostly on level ground; the mountain ravines are held by raw aborigines, and troops are stationed at every strategic point.

sentences.zh: 民間不需鳥槍，懇仍舊例禁止。」

translations.literal: The populace has no need of muskets; I earnestly request that the old prohibition remain in force.
translations.idiomatic: The populace has no need of muskets; I earnestly request that the old prohibition remain in force."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: His request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十一年，請老，加太子少保，食全俸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he requested retirement on account of age; he was advanced to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted his full salary.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1746) he requested retirement on account of age. He was advanced to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted his full salary.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，卒於家，賜祭葬，諡勤愨。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he died at home; sacrificial and burial honors were granted, and he was posthumously titled Qinque.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year (1756) he died at home and was granted state funeral honors, with the posthumous title Qinque (Diligent and Sincere).

sentences.zh: 守乾官至南昌總兵。

translations.literal: Shouqian rose in office to commander-in-chief at Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: Shouqian rose in office to commander-in-chief at Nanchang.

sentences.zh: 宋愛，字體仁，陝西靖遠人。

translations.literal: Song Ai, courtesy name Tiren, was a native of Jingyuan in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Song Ai, courtesy name Tiren, was from Jingyuan in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 父可進，雍正初，以京營參將從撫遠大將軍年羹堯討羅卜藏丹津。

translations.literal: His father Kejin, at the beginning of Yongzheng, served as a brigade commander in the capital garrison and followed the Pacification Commissioner General Nian Gengyao in campaigning against Lobzang Danjin.
translations.idiomatic: His father Kejin, at the beginning of the Yongzheng reign, served as a brigade commander in the capital garrison and followed the Pacification Commissioner General Nian Gengyao in campaigning against Lobzang Danjin.

sentences.zh: 敵攻鎮海堡，遣赴援，擊殺六百餘人，敵敗走。

translations.literal: When the enemy attacked Zhenhai Fort he was dispatched to its relief, killed more than six hundred men, and the enemy was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy attacked Zhenhai Fort he was dispatched to its relief, killed more than six hundred men, and the enemy was defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 敵又攻西寧南川口，圍申中堡，復遣赴援，堡兵出夾擊，敵敗走，擢副將。

translations.literal: The enemy again attacked Xining's Nanchuan Pass and besieged Shenzhong Fort; he was again dispatched to its relief; the fort troops came out in pincer attack, the enemy was defeated and fled, and he was promoted to deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy again attacked Xining's Nanchuan Pass and besieged Shenzhong Fort. He was again dispatched to its relief; the fort troops came out in a pincer attack, the enemy was defeated and fled, and he was promoted to deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 從提督岳鍾琪攻郭隆寺，毀寨七，焚其屋宇七十餘所。

translations.literal: He followed Provincial Commander Yue Zhongqi in attacking Guolong Temple, destroyed seven stockades, and burned more than seventy of their buildings.
translations.idiomatic: He served under Provincial Commander Yue Zhongqi in the attack on Guolong Temple, destroyed seven stockades, and burned more than seventy of their buildings.

sentences.zh: 旋與鍾琪分道深入，定青海。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he and Zhongqi advanced by separate routes deep into the country and pacified Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he and Yue Zhongqi advanced by separate routes deep into the country and pacified Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 擢涼州總兵，授三等阿達哈哈番世職。

translations.literal: He was promoted to commander-in-chief at Liangzhou and granted the third-rank hereditary title of Adaha Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to commander-in-chief at Liangzhou and granted the third-rank hereditary title of Adaha Banner.

sentences.zh: 復從鍾琪攻謝爾蘇土番，戰桌子山，圍之七晝夜，一日數接戰。

translations.literal: He again followed Zhongqi in attacking the Xie'ersu Tibetans; they fought at Zhuozi Mountain, besieged it for seven days and nights, and joined battle several times in a single day.
translations.idiomatic: He again served under Yue Zhongqi in the attack on the Xie'ersu Tibetans. They fought at Zhuozi Mountain, besieged it for seven days and nights, and joined battle several times in a single day.

sentences.zh: 可進受重創，奮進破其巢，遂討平之，擢甘州提督。

translations.literal: Kejin received severe wounds, pressed forward vigorously and broke their stronghold, and thus suppressed them entirely; he was promoted to provincial military commander of Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Kejin sustained severe wounds, pressed forward vigorously and broke their stronghold, and thus suppressed them entirely. He was promoted to provincial military commander of Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 愛，雍正元年武進士，授三等侍衛。

translations.literal: Ai, in the first year of Yongzheng a military jinshi, was appointed a third-rank imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Song Ai, having placed in the military jinshi examination in the first year of the Yongzheng reign (1723), was appointed a third-rank imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 二年，命省可進軍中。

translations.literal: In the second year he was ordered to visit Kejin in the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year (1724) he was ordered to visit Kejin in the army.

sentences.zh: 桌子山之戰，愛從可進奮戰有功。

translations.literal: In the battle of Zhuozi Mountain, Ai followed Kejin in fighting fiercely and performed meritorious service.
translations.idiomatic: In the battle of Zhuozi Mountain, Song Ai followed Kejin in fighting fiercely and performed meritorious service.

sentences.zh: 河南河北鎮總兵紀成斌請以愛授河南開封都司，上疑成斌受羹堯指，允其請，即令愛傳諭詰成斌。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief Ji Chengbin of Henan and Hebei requested that Ai be appointed battalion director at Kaifeng in Henan; the emperor suspected Chengbin had received instructions from Gengyao, approved the request, and immediately ordered Ai to deliver an edict questioning Chengbin.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-Chief Ji Chengbin of Henan and Hebei requested that Song Ai be appointed battalion director at Kaifeng in Henan. The emperor suspected Chengbin had received instructions from Nian Gengyao, approved the request, and immediately ordered Song Ai to deliver an edict questioning Chengbin.

sentences.zh: 成斌奏：「開封都司，省會重地，去年剿桌子山，親見愛奮不顧身，極有膽氣。

translations.literal: Chengbin memorialized: "The battalion directorship at Kaifeng is a post of weight in the provincial capital; last year in suppressing Zhuozi Mountain I personally saw Ai fight without regard for his life—he has great courage.
translations.idiomatic: Chengbin memorialized: "The battalion directorship at Kaifeng is a post of weight in the provincial capital. Last year in suppressing Zhuozi Mountain I personally saw Song Ai fight without regard for his life—he has great courage.

sentences.zh: 且代可進料理營務，頗有才幹。

translations.literal: Moreover he stood in for Kejin in managing camp affairs and showed considerable ability.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover he stood in for Kejin in managing camp affairs and showed considerable ability.

sentences.zh: 知其能勝任，故​​冒昧陳請。

translations.literal: Knowing he could fill the post, I therefore presumptuously memorialized the request.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing he could fill the post, I therefore presumptuously memorialized the request.

sentences.zh: 臣實未受何人囑託，即可進亦不過同在軍中相識，素無交情。」

translations.literal: Your servant truly received no one's entrustment; even Kejin was no more than an acquaintance from serving together in the army, with no prior friendship."
translations.idiomatic: Your servant truly received no one's entrustment; even Kejin was no more than an acquaintance from serving together in the army, with no prior friendship."

sentences.zh: 上諭之曰：「朕原不過揣度之辭。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed him: "I originally spoke only out of suspicion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed him: "I originally spoke only out of suspicion.

sentences.zh: 近年年羹堯握兵柄，若爾等蔑國恩，重私誼，甚非朕保全功臣之意。

translations.literal: In recent years Nian Gengyao has held military power; if you and others scorn the state's grace and value private ties, that is very far from My intent to preserve meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years Nian Gengyao has held military power. If you and others scorn the state's grace and value private ties, that is very far from My intent to preserve meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 今既無別故，意在為地得人，朕甚嘉賞。」

translations.literal: Now that there is no other reason and the intent is to place the right man in the right post, I greatly commend this."
translations.idiomatic: Now that there is no other reason and the intent is to place the right man in the right post, I greatly commend this."

sentences.zh: 再遷浙江紹興副將，命署總兵，歷南陽、永州、天津、定海諸鎮。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to deputy commander at Shaoxing in Zhejiang, ordered to act as commander-in-chief, and served at the garrisons of Nanyang, Yongzhou, Tianjin, Dinghai, and others.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to deputy commander at Shaoxing in Zhejiang, ordered to act as commander-in-chief, and served at the garrisons of Nanyang, Yongzhou, Tianjin, Dinghai, and others.

sentences.zh: 乾隆六年，擢襄陽總兵。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Qianlong he was promoted to commander-in-chief at Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Qianlong reign (1741) he was promoted to commander-in-chief at Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 七年，調安籠。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to Anlong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1742) he was transferred to Anlong.

sentences.zh: 十年，貴州總督張廣泗奏言：「古州系新闢苗疆，諸鎮中惟愛詳慎周密，年力正壯，請以調補。」

translations.literal: In the tenth year Guizhou Governor-General Zhang Guangsi memorialized: "Guzhou is newly opened Miao territory; among the various garrison commanders only Ai is thorough, cautious, and meticulous, and his years and strength are in their prime—I request he be transferred to fill the post.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year (1745) Guizhou Governor-General Zhang Guangsi memorialized: "Guzhou is newly opened Miao territory. Among the various garrison commanders only Song Ai is thorough, cautious, and meticulous, and he is still in the prime of life. I request that he be transferred to fill the post."

sentences.zh: 上從之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，命暫署，服闋後真除。

translations.literal: When he entered mourning for his mother he was ordered to serve temporarily in the post; after the mourning period ended he was formally appointed.
translations.idiomatic: When he entered mourning for his mother he was ordered to serve temporarily in the post; after the mourning period ended he was formally appointed.

sentences.zh: 十八年，擢貴州提督。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was promoted to provincial military commander of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year (1753) he was promoted to provincial military commander of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 前提督丁士傑奏言古州苗因公役使不從，恐激成驕抗，諭將吏彈壓。

translations.literal: The previous provincial commander Ding Shijie had memorialized that the Guzhou Miao, refusing corvée labor, might be provoked into arrogant resistance, and an edict was issued instructing officials to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: The previous provincial commander Ding Shijie had memorialized that the Guzhou Miao, refusing corvée labor, might be provoked into arrogant resistance, and an edict was issued instructing officials to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 愛奏：「古州苗於應備夫役，一呼即至，初未見遲延。

translations.literal: Ai memorialized: "The Guzhou Miao, when corvée labor is required of them, come at a single summons and at first showed no delay.
translations.idiomatic: Song Ai memorialized: "The Guzhou Miao, when corvée labor is required of them, come at a single summons and at first showed no delay.

sentences.zh: 所屬新疆苗民，亦不至驕抗。

translations.literal: The Miao subjects of the newly pacified territory under his command likewise have not become arrogantly resistant.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao subjects of the newly pacified territory under his command likewise have not become arrogantly resistant.

sentences.zh: 苗性難馴，惟在有司善於約束。

translations.literal: The nature of the Miao is hard to tame; it depends only on local officials being skilled at restraint.
translations.idiomatic: The nature of the Miao is hard to tame; it depends only on local officials being skilled at restraint.

sentences.zh: 平時不煩苛，有事不姑息。

translations.literal: In ordinary times he does not trouble them with harsh demands; when there is business he does not indulge them.
translations.idiomatic: In ordinary times he does not burden them with harsh demands; when trouble arises he does not indulge them.

sentences.zh: 務使懷德，兼知畏法。」

translations.literal: He strives to make them cherish virtue and also know to fear the law.
translations.idiomatic: He strives to make them cherish imperial grace while also learning to fear the law."

sentences.zh: 上褒勉之。

translations.literal: The emperor praised and encouraged him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and encouraged him.

sentences.zh: 十九年，總督碩色劾愛馬政廢弛，又為故鎮遠總兵吳三傑勼資治喪。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Governor-General Shuo Se memorialized impeaching Ai for laxity in horse administration, and also for having raised funds to conduct mourning for the late Commander-in-Chief Wu Sanjie of Zhenyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year (1754) Governor-General Shuo Se memorialized impeaching Ai for laxity in horse administration, and also for having raised funds to conduct mourning for the late Commander-in-Chief Wu Sanjie of Zhenyuan.

sentences.zh: 會愛卒，寢其奏。

translations.literal: Just then Ai died, and the memorial was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: Ai died at about that time, and the memorial was shelved.

sentences.zh: 論曰：雍正間文武多通用，高其位以提督迳授大學士為最著。

translations.literal: The commentator says: During the Yongzheng period civil and military offices were often interchangeable; the most striking case was elevating a provincial military commander directly to Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: During the Yongzheng period civil and military offices were often interchangeable; the most striking case was elevating a provincial military commander directly to Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 會伯、振揚皆長兵部，然會伯未上官，振揚不久改右班，其績仍在專閫。

translations.literal: Huibo and Zhenyang both headed the Ministry of War, yet Huibo never actually took office at the ministry, and Zhenyang soon moved to the right-hand corps of officials; their achievements still lay chiefly in frontier command.
translations.idiomatic: Huibo and Zhenyang both headed the Ministry of War, yet Huibo never actually took up office at the ministry, and Zhenyang soon moved to the right-hand corps of officials; their real achievements still lay chiefly in frontier command.

sentences.zh: 良輔為疆吏，卓卓有建白，家世出將，與會伯略同。

translations.literal: Liangfu was a frontier official with outstanding constructive proposals; his family for generations produced generals, much like Huibo.
translations.idiomatic: Liangfu was a frontier official with outstanding policy proposals; his family had produced generals for generations, much like Huibo.

sentences.zh: 天縱、郡、愛等弭亂綏氓，因事有功。

translations.literal: Tianzong, Jun, Ai, and the like quelled disorder and pacified the people, winning merit as occasions arose.
translations.idiomatic: Tianzong, Jun, Ai, and the like quelled disorder and pacified the people, winning merit as occasions arose.

sentences.zh: 年羹堯部將如宋可進、黃喜林、武正安、周瑛、王嵩、馬忠孝，岳鍾琪部將如紀成斌、曹勷、張元佐，皆相從轉戰，惟可進以有子愛，名字猶可見，他皆不具始末。

translations.literal: Nian Gengyao's subordinate generals such as Song Kejin, Huang Xilin, Wu Zheng'an, Zhou Ying, Wang Song, and Ma Zhongxiao, and Yue Zhongqi's subordinate generals such as Ji Chengbin, Cao Xun, and Zhang Yuanzuo, all followed them through successive campaigns; only Kejin, because he had a son Ai, still has his name preserved— the others are not given full accounts of their careers.
translations.idiomatic: Nian Gengyao's subordinate generals such as Song Kejin, Huang Xilin, Wu Zheng'an, Zhou Ying, Wang Song, and Ma Zhongxiao, and Yue Zhongqi's subordinate generals such as Ji Chengbin, Cao Xun, and Zhang Yuanzuo, all followed them through successive campaigns. Only Kejin, because he had a son in Song Ai, still has his name preserved here; the others are not given full accounts of their careers.

sentences.zh: 成斌、勷且以微罪死，是亦重可哀已！

translations.literal: Chengbin and Xun moreover died for minor offenses— this too is deeply lamentable!
translations.idiomatic: Chengbin and Xun moreover died for minor offenses— this too is deeply lamentable!
